books.title: EXQUISITE CORPSES: FOX MASK KILLER #1
books.creators: Che Grayson (writer), Adam Gorham and Jordie Bellaire (artists), Becca Carey (additional creator credit)
verifiedFacts: Miniseries premiere spun out of Exquisite Corpses and focused on the Fox Mask Killer.
Variants include 1:50 Mike Huddleston and 1:100 InHyuk Lee incentives.
Current retailer listings independently identify Aug. 24 as FOC.
marketEvidence: Parent Exquisite Corpses #1 has substantial 2026 completed-sale evidence: recent raw Cover A sales include $42.99, $32.00, $28.00 and $25.00, while multiple CGC 9.8 sales are above $100.
This is stronger evidence than creator hype alone, although parent-title performance does not guarantee the spin-off.
Retailer sell-outs/preorders for incentives are asking/preorder evidence, not completed sales.
books.thesis: Strongest risk-adjusted current FOC thesis because the franchise has demonstrated real aftermarket demand on standard copies. The $4.99 entry and focused spin-off create upside optionality. Keep the position to one copy because actual supply is unknown.

books.title: AVENGERS #1
verifiedFacts: New ongoing Avengers series after Avengers: Armageddon.
Marvel says the team includes Spider-Man, Wolverine, Captain Marvel, Daredevil, Luke Cage and an unrevealed new hero.
PRH Comics Retail lists Nov. 4 release and Aug. 24 FOC.
Incentives include 1:25, 1:50, 1:100 and 1:200 variants, plus numerous open-order covers and a True Believers blind-bag program.
marketEvidence: Several retailers show incentive variants sold out at preorder, demonstrating interest but not completed-sale demand.
Completed sales for Zdarsky/Checchetto Daredevil show standard copies can remain near cover while scarce second-print/incentive material can command premiums.
No completed sales exist for this unreleased Avengers #1.
books.thesis: Important Marvel launch with a strong creative team, but the supply side is visibly aggressive. Standard-copy BUY is not justified yet. WATCH for retailer ordering, first-appearance information and variant demand; acquire only at or below cover if evidence strengthens.

books.title: IT DEMANDS SACRIFICE #1
books.creators: Philip Gelatt and David Yarovesky (writers), Adam Pollina (artist)
verifiedFacts: Four-issue prestige horror series from Bad Idea.
Comic Previews lists Sept. 23 release and Aug. 24 FOC.
Standard cover is $5.99; variants include 1:20, 1:50 and 1:100 incentives plus specialty covers.
Premise centers on a goat family targeted by a satanic cult and demon-summoning ritual.
marketEvidence: Retailers list some incentive variants as sold out, but these are preorder/asking signals, not completed sales.
No credible completed-sale evidence exists for the unreleased issue.
Creator package is notable, but comic-specific aftermarket demand is unproven.
books.thesis: Potentially marketable horror concept and aggressive variant architecture, but evidence is too dependent on novelty and preorder behavior. Do not repeat the Minotaur creator-hype error. WATCH rather than BUY.

books.title: MARVEL MANGAVERSE: GHOSTLOCKE #1
books.creators: Alyssa Wong (writer), Michael YG (artist), Yuji Kaku (cover)
verifiedFacts: One-shot in Marvel's five-part Mangaverse 25th-anniversary program.
Features Kwannon as Ghostlocke/Ghost Rider pursuing Cletus Kasady/Carnage.
PRH lists $4.99, Sept. 23 release and Aug. 24 FOC.
marketEvidence: No comic-specific completed-sale evidence exists because it is unreleased.
Key Collector's low/mid/high guide is not completed-sale evidence.
Marvel IP and anniversary significance do not establish demand exceeding supply.
books.thesis: Interesting mash-up, but a likely high-supply Marvel one-shot with no demonstrated aftermarket demand. PASS.

books.title: FANTASTIC FOUR: FIRST FOES — DRAGON MAN #1
books.creators: Greg Pak (writer), Mark Buckingham (artist), Miguel Mercado and others on variants/covers
verifiedFacts: One-shot focused on Dragon Man and tied to the Fantastic Four film-era program.
PRH lists $4.99, 32 pages, Sept. 23 release and Aug. 24 FOC.
marketEvidence: No completed-sale evidence exists because the issue is unreleased.
Film adjacency provides an audience, but no verified evidence shows demand exceeding likely Marvel one-shot supply.
No verified major first appearance was established.
books.thesis: Recognizable character and film adjacency are insufficient for an investment BUY. PASS.
